title: TheGladiator's Ghosting Anomaly
narrative_script: Anomaly Log 010. The Subject is a Roman Gladiator, currently refreshing a dating app after a match. Biometrics indicate severe [dopamine] crash.
Adrenaline pathways misfire. They survived the Colosseum, but their nervous system is being [weaponized] by a glowing rectangle.
Ancient biology is entirely incompatible with [weaponized] Silicon Valley code. The Subject is performing unpaid data entry for an [algorithm].
Willpower cannot defeat a supercomputer. A structural [override] is required.
To quarantine the code and restore historical dopamine baselines, the Extraction [Protocol] is in the bio.
